reason: The accepted read-only LLMGauge commit 595e177 does not expose faithful public execution contracts for the producer suite. Its own external-benchmark contract explicitly marks MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and IFEval unsupported and prohibits recreating them as native prompts. The campaign did not label proxy prompts as producer-benchmark reproduction.
product_gap: Faithful execution/import contracts for the remaining producer suite elements (IFBench, Multi-IF, BFCLv4, AIME25) are unavailable in the accepted LLMGauge installation. No LLMGauge source was modified.
direct_evidence_used_instead: Versioned local direct-llama.cpp practical, tool, extraction, coding, and context lanes are reported separately and are not claimed to reproduce producer aggregate scores.
